one_liner_zh: 伊頓EPS幾乎符合預期，電氣化題材延續但本季驚喜有限。
one_liner_en: Eaton's EPS came essentially in line, with the electrification theme intact but limited quarterly surprise.
beat_or_miss: 符合預期：EPS 3.33幾乎等於預期3.32（+0.34%）。
ai_view_zh: 訊號中性偏正：EPS幾乎完全符合預期，屬穩健執行但本季缺乏驚喜，電氣化結構性題材仍是長期主軸。短期高本益比使股價對訂單與指引敏感，缺乏營收年增資料使成長判讀保守。中期關鍵在訂單出貨比與利潤率。追蹤指標：電氣事業有機營收與訂單出貨比、積壓訂單、區段營業利潤率、資料中心營收佔比，以及全年EPS與營收指引方向。
ai_view_en: Signal is neutral-to-positive: EPS landed essentially in line, reflecting steady execution but lacking quarterly surprise, with the electrification structural theme remaining the long-term driver. Near-term, the high P/E makes the stock sensitive to orders and guidance, while the missing revenue YoY keeps the growth read conservative. Mid-term, book-to-bill and margins are key. Track: electrical organic revenue and book-to-bill, backlog, segment operating margins, data-center revenue mix, and the direction of full-year EPS and revenue guidance.
highlights_zh: EPS 3.33美元，幾乎符合預期3.32美元，驚喜僅0.34%
營收70.5億美元，營運規模穩健
電氣化與資料中心需求支撐長期訂單成長
積壓訂單與多角化事業提供穩定性
highlights_en: EPS of $3.33 was essentially in line with the $3.32 estimate, just a 0.34% surprise
Revenue of $7.05B reflects a solid operating base
Electrification and data-center demand support long-term order growth
Backlog and diversified businesses provide stability
risks_zh: 營收年增資料缺失，成長趨勢判讀受限
本益比40.19偏高，缺乏驚喜時評價承壓
終端市場景氣循環與供應鏈風險
risks_en: Missing revenue YoY limits the read on growth trends
A 40.19x P/E is elevated, pressuring valuation absent surprises
